annotations.text:
Swiss-turned-up, per brief 2 §6.

One grotesk (Helvetica, condensed cut for headlines), strict grid, flush left, entry motion under 600ms. Headline and numeral scale up 2–3×. Warm paper ground, hairlines, no rounded cards, no shadows, no gradients, no illustration.

Every number and every string is real, read out of the repo.
The photo slots are marked placeholders, not pictures. No Brevik press image is licensed yet — see the Photo treatment board for what each one has to carry before it ships.
